accessLegend.full: Full text read at cited URL
accessLegend.secondary: Known via attributed quotation or trusted secondary description

confidenceLegend.high: Directly inspected primary or open source; transfer to slides reasoned
confidenceLegend.limited: Spec silent or anecdotal; consensus without controlled study
confidenceLegend.lore: Practitioner heuristic with no traceable empirical origin
confidenceLegend.low: Single secondary source; needs rendered or human validation
confidenceLegend.medium: Secondary but consistent across independent sources

principles.applicability: Direct: kicker/title/body/caption roles; body measure and leading tokens.
principles.author: Matthew Butterick
principles.derivedPrinciple: Decide body size/measure/leading first; keep slide lines within 45-90 chars with 120-145% leading.
principles.implementationStatus: partial (body leading tokens exist; measure caps missing)
principles.limitations: Document-first context; display/projection extremes need validation.
principles.principle: Body text first: size, measure, leading, and font before display decisions.
principles.reference: https://practicaltypography.com/ (homepage, summary-of-key-rules, line-length read FULL)
principles.summary: Decide body text first (size, line length, leading, font); 45-90 characters per line including spaces; body leading 120-145%.

principles.applicability: Direct: kicker tracking, emphasis policy (no italics engine-wide).
principles.author: Matthew Butterick
principles.derivedPrinciple: Track tracked caps/small-caps only (+5-12%); emphasis via bold for sans, never bold+italic.
principles.implementationStatus: partial (weights adopted; kicker tracking exceeds guidance)
principles.limitations: Display microtype may justify wider tracking; 34% risks letter-by-letter reading.
principles.principle: Letterspace caps only (+5-12%); bold OR italic, never both.
principles.reference: https://practicaltypography.com/letterspacing + /bold-or-italic (read FULL)
principles.summary: Add 5-12% tracking on all-caps/small-caps, never lowercase (except tiny sizes); use bold or italic, never both; sans emphasis via bold.

principles.applicability: Direct: coarse per-system grids; no baseline grid for single-column slides.
principles.author: Matthew Butterick
principles.derivedPrinciple: Coarse grids guide visible and invisible elements; eyes beat calculators; baseline grids only for wide multi-column.
principles.implementationStatus: implemented (coarse grids, no baseline grid)
principles.limitations: Preference against modular-scale mysticism recorded, not a rule.
principles.principle: Coarse, simple grids; eyes judge over calculators.
principles.reference: https://practicaltypography.com/grids (read FULL)
principles.summary: Grids guide position/size/alignment of visible and invisible elements; coarser grids give more consistency; eyes beat calculators.

principles.applicability: Direct: Editorial left-ragged; Expressive centering bounded to hero-length lines.
principles.author: Matthew Butterick
principles.derivedPrinciple: Asymmetry is safe; center only short phrases/titles, never whole blocks.
principles.implementationStatus: partial (editorial ok; expressive centers bodies)
principles.limitations: Hero titles treated as the narrow exception; needs A/B comparison.
principles.principle: Asymmetry is fine; centered blocks are hard to read and align.
principles.reference: https://practicaltypography.com/centered-text (read FULL)
principles.summary: Asymmetry is nothing to fear; centered blocks are hard to read (both edges ragged); center only short phrases/titles.

principles.applicability: Direct: slide-specific page; paper/ink pairs, stable role sizes, restrained color.
principles.author: Matthew Butterick
principles.derivedPrinciple: Dark room: black field, thin sans, gray-not-white type; hold one base size deck-wide; no auto-resize-to-fit; confine layout below full width.
principles.implementationStatus: partial (colors adapted; engine still shrinks to 0.13x tail)
principles.limitations: Engine must fit arbitrary text, so wrap-first/shrink-second with stable roles is the adaptation.
principles.principle: Presentation rules: dark-room fields, stable base size, no autofit, restrained width.
principles.reference: https://practicaltypography.com/presentations (read FULL)
principles.summary: Dark room: black background, thin sans, gray type; pick one base size fitting 12-15 lines and hold it; turn off auto-resize-to-fit; confine layout below full width.

principles.applicability: Direct: rhythm-unit spacing, scale discipline, numeral policy.
principles.author: Richard Rutter
principles.derivedPrinciple: Control measure elastically; space vertically in measured rhythm intervals; keep a disciplined scale; letterspace caps/digits.
principles.implementationStatus: partial (rhythm step exists; scale intervals fixed)
principles.limitations: Web/CSS medium; projection transfer is derived.
principles.principle: Elastic measure, vertical rhythm, scale discipline, letterspaced caps/digits.
principles.reference: https://webtypography.net/toc + /2.1.2 + /3.1.1 + /bibliography (read FULL); https://book.webtypography.net/ (book page FULL)
principles.sourceTitle: The Elements of Typographic Style Applied to the Web + Web Typography (book)
principles.summary: Elastic/liquid measure control; comfortable measure per Bringhurst range; vertical rhythm in measured intervals; scale discipline; letterspace caps/digits, never lowercase without reason.

principles.applicability: Measure and scale ideas supported; slide adaptations are derived heuristics.
principles.author: Robert Bringhurst
principles.derivedPrinciple: Bodies <=~60 chars/line, titles <=2 lines, fixed role scales per system.
principles.implementationStatus: missing (measure caps not enforced)
principles.limitations: Serif book-text context; display/projection needs own validation.
principles.principle: Serve the reader; 45-75 char measure (66 ideal); modest set of related size intervals.
principles.reference: ISBN 9780881792126; attributed quotes inside FULL-read Rutter pages (fair-use gist only)
principles.sourceTitle: The Elements of Typographic Style (4th ed.)
principles.summary: Serve the reader; 45-75 char measure (66 ideal single-column serif; 40-50 multi-column); compose from modest distinct related size intervals; letterspace caps/small-caps and long digit strings.

principles.applicability: Lineage for Swiss grammar (columns, left alignment, consistency); numeric grid specifics are derived.
principles.author: Josef Muller-Brockmann
principles.derivedPrinciple: Swiss: shared column/module grid, asymmetric sans composition; slides use coarse grids, not 8-32 print fields.
principles.implementationStatus: partial (Swiss 4-col hardcode; coarse-grid rationale adopted)
principles.limitations: Print-page grids do not transfer numerically to 16:9 projection.
principles.principle: Construction grids impose objective order; asymmetric minimal-ornament composition.
principles.reference: ISBN 978-3-7212-0145-1; Rutter bibliography endorsement read FULL; year/publisher via review+biblio snippets
principles.summary: Construction grids impose objective order; typographic/pictorial elements aligned to shared columns/modules; asymmetric, sans-serif, minimal-ornament composition.

principles.applicability: Grammar-level only (strict columns, ragged-right sans, tight leading).
principles.author: Emil Ruder
principles.derivedPrinciple: Swiss grammar: function over decoration; structure/grid/rhythm/proportion serve readability.
principles.implementationStatus: partial (Swiss grammar adopted; no Ruder-specific rule cited)
principles.limitations: No verifiable body excerpt; Basel-school print context.
principles.principle: Function over decoration; systems of structure, grid, rhythm, proportion.
principles.reference: https://niggli.ch/en/products/typographie (publisher page FULL); ISBN 978-3-7212-0043-0
principles.summary: Function over decoration; systems of structure, grid, rhythm, proportion serving readability.

principles.applicability: Hierarchy-via-contrast and letter/text/grid framing for role system + grid critique.
principles.author: Ellen Lupton
principles.derivedPrinciple: Hierarchy through contrast/scale/proportion; whitespace discipline; legibility vs readability split.
principles.implementationStatus: partial (role contrast exists; numeric rules not attributed)
principles.limitations: No primary excerpt; general-design context, not slides.
principles.principle: Typography as tool for action; hierarchy via contrast/scale/proportion.
principles.reference: ISBN 9781568989693 (2nd ed.); Blinkist summary read FULL + review snippets; thinkingwithtype.com unreachable
principles.summary: Typography as tool for action (shape content, enable message flow); organized letter/text/grid; hierarchy through contrast/scale/proportion; legibility vs readability.

principles.applicability: Historical root of Swiss asymmetric grammar; slide geometry derived.
principles.author: Jan Tschichold
principles.derivedPrinciple: Asymmetric composition as dynamic functional default; sans-serif, flush-left, whitespace, meaningful contrast.
principles.implementationStatus: partial (Swiss asymmetry adopted as lineage)
principles.limitations: 1928 commercial-print context; later Tschichold revised toward symmetric/classical.
principles.principle: Clarity as essence; asymmetric functional composition.
principles.reference: Die neue Typographie (Berlin, 1928); English transl. UC Press 1995; De Gruyter intro + Eye Magazine snippets; designhistory.org unreachable (expired cert)
principles.sourceTitle: Die neue Typographie / The New Typography
principles.summary: Clarity as essence; asymmetric composition as dynamic functional default; sans-serif, flush-left, whitespace, meaningful color/contrast.

principles.applicability: Lineage for Expressive system (display voice, centered dramatic type); no numeric rule.
principles.author: Wolfgang Weingart
principles.derivedPrinciple: Expressive license bounded by readability evidence; grid-breaking is deliberate exception, not default.
principles.implementationStatus: partial (expressive voice exists; bounds not enforced)
principles.limitations: Anti-system philosophy resists rule extraction; print/collage context.
principles.principle: Mastered Swiss grid then systematically broke it (New Wave/Swiss Punk); emotion-bearing type.
principles.reference: ISBN 9783907044865; Hue&Eye article read FULL (secondary)
principles.summary: Mastered Swiss grid then systematically broke it from 1960s; expressive layouts, letter-spacing/text-layering experiments, emotion-bearing type.

principles.applicability: Compositional method for grid-critique workflow; measurements derived.
principles.author: Kimberly Elam
principles.derivedPrinciple: Grids as visible organizing frameworks relating type/space through proportion, rhythm, hierarchy.
principles.implementationStatus: missing (method noted; no Elam-attributed measurement)
principles.limitations: Zero body pages read; example-driven pedagogy, not a rule table.
principles.principle: Grids as visible frameworks: proportion, symmetry, geometric systems.
principles.reference: ISBN 1-56898-465-0; legal 14-page preview (front matter/copyright only) + publisher description
principles.sourceTitle: Grid Systems: Principles of Organizing Type
principles.summary: Grids as visible organizing frameworks relating type/image/space through proportion, rhythm, hierarchy; 100+ Bauhaus-to-Nike examples.

principles.applicability: High: proximity groups related items; similarity keeps same-category type consistent; alignment aids closure/continuity.
principles.author: Max Wertheimer
principles.derivedPrinciple: Group by proximity first; similarity for same-category roles; alignment for closure/continuity.
principles.implementationStatus: partial (role consistency + alignment exist; proximity scoring missing)
principles.limitations: Qualitative laws, no effect sizes; cue priority is context-dependent.
principles.principle: Gestalt grouping: proximity, similarity, closure, continuity, common fate.
principles.reference: Wertheimer 1923 (German); English in Ellis 1938 A Source Book of Gestalt Psychology; summaries ubiquitous; original mostly paywalled/library
principles.sourceTitle: Laws of Organization in Perceptual Forms
principles.summary: Perceptual grouping by proximity, similarity, closure, continuity, common fate; descriptive laws without fixed priority.

principles.applicability: High: same-panel background and connecting alignment are strongest grouping cues; often beat proximity.
principles.author: Stephen Palmer; Palmer & Rock
principles.derivedPrinciple: Prefer common-region (shared background band) and uniform-connectedness (alignment threads) for related content.
principles.implementationStatus: missing
principles.limitations: Lab stimuli (dots/lines), not slide layouts; interaction strengths need judgment.
principles.principle: Common region + uniform connectedness as strong grouping cues.
principles.reference: Palmer 1992; Palmer & Rock 1994 Psychonomic Bulletin & Review (paywalled); MITECS encyclopedia summary free
principles.sourceTitle: Rethinking perceptual organization: the role of uniform connectedness
principles.summary: Enclosing related content (common region) and connecting with lines/borders (uniform connectedness) are among the strongest grouping cues.

principles.applicability: High: text must separate cleanly from background; busy/low-contrast overlays kill legibility.
principles.author: Edgar Rubin; Peterson (review)
principles.derivedPrinciple: Guarantee figure-ground separation via contrast and quiet backgrounds; no textured/gradient fields.
principles.implementationStatus: partial (solid backgrounds + contrast tests; comfort unmeasured)
principles.limitations: Classic work is phenomenal/descriptive; thresholds come from contrast/vision literature.
principles.principle: Figure-ground segregation: figure must separate cleanly from ground.
principles.reference: Rubin 1915 Danish thesis (Rubin vase); excerpts in Beardslee & Wertheimer 1958; Peterson Intellectica review PDFs free
principles.summary: Text/figure must separate cleanly from background; busy backgrounds and low-contrast overlays collapse figure-ground.

principles.applicability: High: one key element per slide pops via color/size/orientation; conjunctions do not pop.
principles.author: Anne Treisman & Garry Gelade
principles.derivedPrinciple: Limit to ~1 highlight encoding at a time; conjunctions (red AND tilted) are not preattentive.
principles.implementationStatus: partial (accent reserved for kickers; single-highlight not enforced)
principles.limitations: Lab search arrays, not presentations; pop-out habituates if overused.
principles.principle: Feature Integration Theory: color/orientation/size/motion pop out in parallel.
principles.reference: Treisman & Gelade 1980 Cogn. Psychology 12:97-136 (paywalled); Healey preattentive visualization survey (NCSU, free web)
principles.summary: Color, orientation, size, motion pop out in parallel and guide attention; conjunctions of features are not preattentive.

principles.applicability: Medium-high: titles/questions prime search; high-contrast decoration competes with content.
principles.author: Jeremy Wolfe et al.
principles.derivedPrinciple: Prime with titles/questions; keep decoration low-salience so it does not compete.
principles.implementationStatus: missing
principles.limitations: Model of search efficiency, not comprehension; slide takeaway is indirect.
principles.principle: Guided Search: top-down priming + bottom-up salience jointly guide attention.
principles.reference: Wolfe, Cave & Franzel 1989 JEP:HPP 15(3) (paywalled); Wolfe Getting into Guided Search tutorial preprint free
principles.summary: Top-down guidance (titles prime targets) plus bottom-up salience (high-contrast items compete) jointly determine search efficiency.

principles.applicability: High: governs chart choice when quantities appear as typographic comparison.
principles.author: William Cleveland & Robert McGill; Heer & Bostock (replication)
principles.derivedPrinciple: Encode quantities by position-along-common-scale > length > angle > area > hue.
principles.implementationStatus: missing (typography-only; no chart module)
principles.limitations: Tested ratio-judgment accuracy only, not memorability or persuasion.
principles.principle: Graphical perception ranking: position > length > angle > area > hue.
principles.reference: Cleveland & McGill 1984 JASA (paywalled); Heer & Bostock 2010 crowdsourced replication open; UW/CSE summaries free
principles.summary: Quantities judged most accurately by position-along-common-scale (bars, dot plots), then length, angle, area, color hue.

principles.applicability: Very high: delete extraneous, highlight essentials, adjacent labels, no verbatim read-aloud.
principles.author: John Sweller; Richard Mayer & Roxana Moreno; Mayer & Fiorella
principles.derivedPrinciple: Coherence (strip extraneous), signaling (highlight essentials), spatial contiguity (adjacent labels), redundancy (no verbatim duplication).
principles.implementationStatus: partial (caption adjacency exists; coherence/signaling not scored)
principles.limitations: Lab multimedia lessons with students; business-persuasion slides are extrapolation.
principles.principle: Cognitive Load Theory + multimedia principles with measured effect sizes.
principles.reference: Sweller 1988; Mayer & Moreno 2003 Nine Ways (free PDFs); Mayer & Fiorella 2014 handbook ch.12 (paywalled; d values via summaries)
principles.sourceTitle: Nine Ways to Reduce Cognitive Load in Multimedia Learning
principles.summary: Delete extraneous material (coherence), highlight essentials (signaling d~0.41), adjacent labels (spatial contiguity d~1.1), avoid verbatim text+narration duplication (redundancy).

principles.applicability: High: one message per slide; chunk bullets into 3-4 groups max.
principles.author: George Miller (7); Nelson Cowan (4, revision)
principles.derivedPrinciple: Design to ~4 simultaneously-held chunks, not 7; sequence the rest.
principles.implementationStatus: missing (no chunk limiter)
principles.limitations: Capacity varies with expertise/chunk richness; constrains novel items, not sequenced content.
principles.principle: Working memory capacity ~4 chunks (revised from 7).
principles.reference: Miller 1956 Psych Review; Cowan 2001 Behav. & Brain Sci. (abstract/PubMed free; originals paywalled)
principles.summary: Working memory holds ~3-5 chunks (revision of 7+-2); design to ~4 simultaneously-held novel items.

principles.applicability: Medium: favors bold, large, high-contrast type at projection distance.
principles.author: Fergus Campbell & John Robson
principles.derivedPrinciple: Thin strokes, small low-contrast text, and fine lines disappear first; translate via WCAG + min-size rules.
principles.implementationStatus: partial (contrast tests exist; CSF curve not used directly)
principles.limitations: Measured with sine gratings, not text; do not apply the curve directly.
principles.principle: Contrast Sensitivity Function peaks ~4 cycles/degree, falls at high frequency.
principles.reference: https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/pmc/ (J. Physiology 197:551-566; free PDF via Stanford vista lab, verified fetchable)
principles.sourceTitle: Application of Fourier analysis to the visibility of gratings
principles.summary: Sensitivity peaks ~4 cycles/degree and falls at high spatial frequency: thin/small/low-contrast detail disappears first.

principles.applicability: High: restrained palettes, few fonts, whitespace; each added element raises congestion.
principles.author: Ruth Rosenholtz et al.
principles.derivedPrinciple: Budget color/luminance/orientation variability; justify each added color, font, box.
principles.implementationStatus: missing (no congestion metric)
principles.limitations: Validated on search in maps/scenes; no published max-elements-per-slide threshold.
principles.principle: Visual clutter / Feature Congestion degrades search and recognition.
principles.reference: Rosenholtz, Li & Nakano 2007 J. Vision (OPEN ACCESS); Rosenholtz et al. 2005 Feature Congestion (free via MIT)
principles.summary: Clutter (color/luminance/orientation variability) degrades search and recognition; quantitative congestion model.

principles.applicability: Medium: front-load key content top-left; use headings (layer-cake when headings exist).
principles.author: Jakob Nielsen; Kate Moran / Kim Flaherty (NN/g); Paige Pernice
principles.derivedPrinciple: Front-load key content; F-pattern is a failure mode of dense walls, not a layout target.
principles.implementationStatus: missing
principles.limitations: Web-page reading (LTR), not projected slides; pattern emerges from content/task.
principles.principle: F-pattern scanning: observational eye-tracking pattern on dense text pages.
principles.reference: https://www.nngroup.com/articles/f-shaped-pattern-reading-web-content/ (free article, verified); full reports paywalled
principles.sourceTitle: F-Shaped Pattern... Misunderstood, But Still Relevant (NN/g)
principles.summary: Eye-tracking shows F-shaped scanning on dense pages; supports front-loading and headings; context-dependent, not prescriptive.

principles.applicability: Low as evidence; loose compositional recipe only, never cited as validated.
principles.author: Trade/blog lore (Gutenberg Diagram roots, 1950s print)
principles.derivedPrinciple: May use top-row-then-diagonal as a loose recipe; never present as eye-tracking-validated.
principles.implementationStatus: not-applicable (do not implement as rule)
principles.limitations: No primary eye-tracking study located; presenting it as science is the failure mode.
principles.principle: Z-pattern: design convention / folklore with no primary evidence.
principles.reference: No primary study; flagged UNVERIFIED in design-research audits; Gutenberg Diagram (1950s print) is the lore root
principles.summary: No primary eye-tracking study located; usable as loose compositional recipe only, never equated with F-pattern.

principles.applicability: Medium: default to declutter; memorability goals can favor restrained embellishment.
principles.author: Edward Tufte (doctrine); Bateman et al. 2010 + others (contrary evidence)
principles.derivedPrinciple: Remove non-informative ink by default, not as law; test memorability trade-offs.
principles.implementationStatus: partial (zero-rule policy aligns with default; trade-off untested)
principles.limitations: Tufte cites no controlled studies; embellished charts were MORE memorable in Bateman 2010.
principles.principle: Data-ink ratio / chartjunk: aesthetic-prescriptive doctrine with mixed-to-contrary evidence.
principles.reference: Tufte 1983 Visual Display (book, paywalled); Bateman et al. 2010 Useful Junk CHI (free MIT PDF); Gillan & Sorenson; Inbar et al.
principles.sourceTitle: The Visual Display of Quantitative Information vs Useful Junk (CHI 2010)
principles.summary: Maximize data-ink is taste + weak evidence; embellished charts can be more memorable; never present as proven.

principles.applicability: Very high (title > key point > detail via size/weight/spacing); cite components, not hierarchy as law.
principles.author: Design convention (components: preattentive features, CSF, Gestalt)
principles.derivedPrinciple: Signal importance via size/weight/color/position; specific ratios are taste/convention.
principles.implementationStatus: partial (role scales exist; hierarchy deltas not scored)
principles.limitations: No single primary study; specific type-scale ratios are convention.
principles.principle: Visual hierarchy as convention grounded in supported components.
principles.reference: No single primary study; components trace to B04 (preattentive), B09 (CSF), B01-B02 (Gestalt)
principles.summary: Size/weight/color/position signal importance; grounded in preattentive features, CSF, Gestalt - not itself an experiment.

principles.applicability: Direct to live presentation QA as a heuristic gate.
principles.author: UCSC IBSC tips; UC Merced accessibility checklist; SlideGenius (vendor)
principles.derivedPrinciple: QA every deck from ~6ft / farthest seat; Snellen math is clinical-only, not a slide threshold.
principles.implementationStatus: missing (no distance-indexed QA)
principles.limitations: Heuristic, no controlled validation, no distance-to-size formula; no presentation-validated arcmin threshold.
principles.principle: Viewing-distance test: 6-foot / back-of-room check.
principles.reference: UCSC IBSC tips page; UC Merced accessibility checklist; SlideGenius vendor guidance (all public, free)
principles.summary: View slide from ~6ft or farthest seat; Snellen/visual-angle math (5 arcmin letter) is clinical/print only.

principles.applicability: Logistics/compatibility advice; zero readability research by aspect ratio.
principles.author: Vendor + university guides; Springer Nature 2025 survey claim (unverified)
principles.derivedPrinciple: Match venue display (16:9 default); avoid letterboxing/stretching.
principles.implementationStatus: implemented (13.33x7.5in 16:9 canvas)
principles.limitations: 78%-on-16:9 claim unverified secondary; no readability difference by aspect ratio studied.
principles.principle: 16:9 default; match venue display.
principles.reference: Vendor + university guides (public); Springer Nature 2025 survey claim 78% on 16:9 - unverified secondary
principles.summary: 16:9 (1920x1080) is the current default; match the venue display; no readability research by aspect ratio.

principles.applicability: Chunking/pausing between ideas supported; seconds-per-slide numbers are lore.
principles.author: PLOS Comp Bio; practitioner skills (TED/MIT Comm Lab); Mayer & Chandler 2001; Mayer 2009/2019
principles.derivedPrinciple: One idea per slide; pause between ideas; do not enforce fixed seconds-per-slide.
principles.implementationStatus: partial (one thesis per slide exists; pacing not modeled)
principles.limitations: Fixed 60-90s numbers are lore; segmenting gives no seconds rule.
principles.principle: Pacing: ~60-90s/slide practitioner norm; segmenting principle supports chunking.
principles.reference: PLOS Comp Bio ~1 min/slide; Mayer & Chandler 2001; Mayer 2009/2019 summaries (median d~0.67 segmenting)
principles.summary: Practitioner ~60-90s/slide and 1 idea/slide; learner-paced chunks beat continuous (segmenting d~0.67) but give no seconds rule.

principles.applicability: Directional coherence guidance; no word-count cap is empirically grounded.
principles.author: WestJEM 2017 (Mayer framework); Le Blanc et al. 2025; practitioner 6x6/7x7 lore
principles.derivedPrinciple: Strip extraneous (coherence); do not enforce 6x6/7x7/word caps as validated rules.
principles.implementationStatus: missing (no density scoring)
principles.limitations: WestJEM: density p=0.815 n.s.; LeBlanc full text paywalled (abstract open); caps have no traceable origin.
principles.principle: Text density: field descriptives + coherence principle; caps are lore.
principles.reference: WestJEM 2017 CME study (open access); Le Blanc et al. 2025 The Clinical Teacher (abstract open, full paywalled)
principles.summary: WestJEM: mean 25.6 w/slide, density not significant (p=0.815); LeBlanc: median 38.3 w/slide; 6x6/7x7/1-7-7 rules are lore.

principles.applicability: Strong consensus as practitioner floor; point size is not a visual-angle spec.
principles.author: UC Merced; UCSC; CEFood 2026; Kawasaki; WarsawJS speaker guide
principles.derivedPrinciple: Body >=24pt, headings >=36pt, absolute floor ~18pt, code 18-20pt mono; always pair with distance test.
principles.implementationStatus: partial (role minima exist; some minima below 18pt floor)
principles.limitations: No controlled legibility study for slides; pt thresholds cannot transfer across venues without distance test.
principles.principle: Minimum readable size: practitioner consensus without experiment.
principles.reference: UC Merced checklist; UCSC tips; CEFood 2026 (title 32-40/headings 24-32/body 20-24/captions 18-22); Kawasaki 30pt rule
principles.summary: Consensus: body >=24pt, headings >=36pt, floor ~18pt, code 18-20pt mono; no experiment; pt is not visual angle.

principles.applicability: System goal for venues; content thresholds for slides remain unvalidated.
principles.author: InfoComm 1999 (Blaha seminar); W3C WCAG 2.x; vendor device specs
principles.derivedPrinciple: Design venue systems to >=10:1 in ambient; do not present WCAG 4.5:1/3:1 as validated for projection.
principles.implementationStatus: partial (WCAG AA enforced; ambient washout unmodeled)
principles.limitations: Device ratios are hardware specs; authored contrast collapses under ambient washout.
principles.principle: Projection contrast: 10:1 system goal; WCAG borrowed without validation.
principles.reference: InfoComm 1999 Blaha seminar (public via projector.com mirror); W3C WCAG 2.x (public web evidence)
principles.sourceTitle: Projection contrast guidance (practitioner + borrowed web ratios)
principles.summary: Design goal >=10:1 white/black in operating ambient (practitioner-conference); WCAG 4.5:1/3:1 borrowed for slides without presentation validation.

principles.applicability: Attention guidance via signaling supported; 3s number unvalidated.
principles.author: Nancy Duarte (Slide:ology p.140; HBR); Mayer signaling (26/28 tests d~0.70)
principles.derivedPrinciple: Make slides glanceable; cue organization explicitly; never cite 8-second myth.
principles.implementationStatus: missing
principles.limitations: 3s threshold unvalidated; Microsoft 8-second attention span is pop myth.
principles.principle: Glance test (~3s) doctrine + validated signaling principle.
principles.reference: Duarte HBR + Slide:ology p.140 (public practitioner doctrine); Mayer signaling summaries (26/28 tests, d~0.70)
principles.summary: Slide graspable in ~3s, glance media like billboards (doctrine, unvalidated); signaling cues highlighting organization (d~0.70).

principles.applicability: Strongest experimental base directly applicable to narration-vs-text decisions.
principles.author: Richard Mayer; Moreno & Mayer 2002; Mayer & Johnson (revision)
principles.derivedPrinciple: Narration+graphic over text+graphic; no verbatim duplication; short 2-3 word redundant labels help (d=0.47-0.70).
principles.implementationStatus: missing (narration not modeled; captions are source tags, not redundant labels)
principles.limitations: Lab multimedia-lesson studies, not live keynote rooms; closest validated evidence in track.
principles.principle: Modality + redundancy principles; short-label revision.
principles.reference: Mayer modality/redundancy summaries (public); Moreno & Mayer 2002 lightning studies; Mayer & Johnson short-label revision
principles.sourceTitle: Modality and redundancy principles (+ short-label revision)
principles.summary: Narration+graphic beats text+graphic (modality); duplicating narration as text hurts (redundancy); short 2-3 word labels help retention (d=0.47-0.70).

principles.applicability: No direct study; chunking/cueing support is indirect and speaker-paced.
principles.author: Mayer segmenting/signaling (adjacent); Nielsen/NNG progressive disclosure (UX); Beamer build guidance
principles.derivedPrinciple: Chunk and cue across slides (narrative segmentation); do not claim staged-reveal effectiveness.
principles.implementationStatus: not-applicable (transitions out of scope per PRD)
principles.limitations: Reveal pacing is speaker-controlled, so segmenting learner-control may not transfer.
principles.principle: Progressive reveal: no direct evidence; adjacent principles only.
principles.reference: No direct study on bullet-by-bullet reveal vs static slides; NNG progressive disclosure is UX/interface evidence
principles.summary: No direct study on staged in-slide reveal; segmenting/signaling support chunking and cueing only.

principles.applicability: Body line-height 1.6-1.8 and 160% leading consistent with sources; ratio is consensus.
principles.author: W3C KLREQ; Material Design v1; Capestrani (AoDR 2020)
principles.derivedPrinciple: Korean dense script gets extra line height (+1sp Title-Caption; body 1.6-1.8); no pinned optimal ratio.
principles.implementationStatus: partial (body 1.45-1.6; Korean-specific leading missing)
principles.limitations: No controlled study pinning optimal Korean body ratio; 160% is an example, not a recommendation.
principles.principle: Hangul density requires extra line height; no validated optimal ratio.
principles.reference: https://www.w3.org/TR/klreq/ (7.4.1 inspected); https://m1.material.io/style/typography.html (Korean=Dense inspected); https://aodr.org Capestrani 2020 (abstract+PDF inspected)
principles.sourceTitle: KLREQ + Material v1 + Quantitative Insights for Hangeul Typefaces
principles.summary: KLREQ lists 4 line-spacing methods (160% example, no recommended ratio); Material: Korean dense, +1sp Title-Caption; Capestrani: stroke 83-170 UPM, isolated-syllable legibility only.

principles.applicability: Direct spec for break engine + kinsoku tables.
principles.author: W3C KLREQ; Unicode UAX #14
principles.derivedPrinciple: Hangul breaks on character OR eojeol basis at author choice; enforce line-head/end bans and no-break runs.
principles.implementationStatus: partial (CJK-char/Latin-word wrap matches options; kinsoku missing)
principles.limitations: KLREQ open issues #8/#12 leave justification interaction underspecified.
principles.principle: Hangul line-breaking rules + kinsoku bans + UAX #14 classes.
principles.reference: https://www.w3.org/TR/klreq/ (7.1.1-7.1.4 inspected); https://www.unicode.org/reports/tr14/tr14-57.html (H2/H3/JL/JV/JT inspected)
principles.sourceTitle: KLREQ line breaking + UAX #14 Line Breaking Algorithm
principles.summary: Hangul breaks char- or word-basis at author choice; line-head bans closers/punct, line-end bans openers; UAX14: justified breaks anywhere, ragged space-based.

principles.applicability: Headings/buttons/labels keep-all; chat/prose keep-all+anywhere; never for JA/ZH running text.
principles.author: MDN; W3C CSS Text 3; Korean-web consensus
principles.derivedPrinciple: word-break:keep-all + overflow-wrap:break-word/anywhere + line-break:strict for Korean.
principles.implementationStatus: missing (engine breaks CJK chars; keep-all opt-in absent)
principles.limitations: Default UAX14/ICU/Chrome lang=ko still breaks between syllables; keep-all is opt-in.
principles.principle: CSS Korean wrapping pattern: keep-all + overflow-wrap escape hatch.
principles.reference: MDN word-break/line-break semantics; W3C CSS Text 3 (open); Tailwind break-keep maps to keep-all
principles.sourceTitle: CSS Text wrapping for Korean (MDN + CSS Text 3)
principles.summary: keep-all = eojeol-unit wrap (fixes mid-eojeol splits); overflow-wrap escapes URLs/identifiers; must not apply to JA/ZH running text.

principles.applicability: Do not autospace Korean; keep single-family mixed lines.
principles.author: W3C KLREQ; CSSWG #9979; w3c/klreq#58
principles.derivedPrinciple: Hangul is neutral for text-autospace: no inserted space Hangul-Hanja or Hangul-alnum.
principles.implementationStatus: implemented (no synthetic Hangul tracking; mixed-script coverage exists)
principles.limitations: No authoritative numeric baseline-offset table; only OpenType BASE mechanism + vendor claims.
principles.principle: Mixed-script alignment: Hangul neutral for autospace; CJK inter-char 0.
principles.reference: https://www.w3.org/TR/klreq/ (3.1.3/7.3.1/7.3.2 inspected); CSSWG #9979 Closed-Accepted; MDN text-autospace + CSS Text 4
principles.summary: Horizontal mixed writing is the norm; CJK inter-char 0; Hangul neutral for autospace (unlike Han-Latin quarter-em).

principles.applicability: Stack Pretendard Variable then system CJK; subset aggressively.
principles.author: Glyphs; Google Fonts CJK spec; Noto Sans KR; Pretendard (Kil Hyung-jin)
principles.derivedPrinciple: Jamo-to-6-layouts model; sTypo 0.88/-0.12, hhea ~1.16/-0.288, BASE required; Pretendard-first for mixed bodies.
principles.implementationStatus: partial (Pretendard-first + fallbacks exist; embedding only for Pretendard)
principles.limitations: Fallback width deltas (e.g. Apple SD ~13.5% narrower than Malgun) are anecdotal, not spec.
principles.principle: Hangul font metrics: em-square + midlines; Jamo composition; metric schemas.
principles.reference: https://glyphsapp.com/learn/creating-a-hangeul-font (inspected); gf-docs/fontbakery vertical metrics; https://github.com/orioncactus/pretendard (OFL, README inspected)
principles.sourceTitle: Hangeul font construction + CJK vertical metrics + Pretendard
principles.summary: Jamo (Cho/Jung/Jong) to 6 syllable-block layouts; CJK uses em-square + midlines; Noto Sans KR 11,172 syllables; Pretendard Inter+SourceHanKR+MPLUS1p, 9wt+variable.

principles.applicability: Use weight steps, not italics, for Korean emphasis.
principles.author: Adobe + Google + Sandoll (Source Han Sans / Noto Sans CJK); KLREQ 4.3 (TBD)
principles.derivedPrinciple: 7 weights EL/L/N/R/M/B/H, variable 100-900; no true italic for Hangul.
principles.implementationStatus: implemented (no italics engine-wide; weight steps exist)
principles.limitations: CJK-bold-reads-heavier / drop-0.5-1pt lore has no perceptual-curve study.
principles.principle: Hangul weight: Source Han 7-weight system; no true italic.
principles.reference: Source Han Sans / Noto Sans CJK repo + ReadMe/DesignGuide (OFL, inspected); KLREQ 4.3 + kore-gap 4.3 TBD Content needed
principles.sourceTitle: Source Han Sans / Noto Sans CJK weight system
principles.summary: 7 weights EL/L/N/R/M/B/H, variable wght 100-900 since 2021; Hangul has no true italic (synthesized oblique problematic).

principles.applicability: Attach ./,/) particles; space after closer before next word; horizontal-first.
principles.author: W3C KLREQ; NIKL / MCST 2014-0039 (via press + Q&A summaries)
principles.derivedPrinciple: Horizontal half-width ,. (U+002C/002E); paren/middle-dot/quarter-width and 1/8-em sign-math rules; NIKL quote/dash conventions.
principles.implementationStatus: missing (punctuation hygiene partial; NIKL rules not encoded)
principles.limitations: Full NIKL commentary PDF not directly inspected; vertical-puncture rules rarely used.
principles.principle: Korean punctuation/spacing: KLREQ normative rules + NIKL conventions.
principles.reference: https://www.w3.org/TR/klreq/ (4.1.2.2/6.1.1-6.1.3/7.3.3-7.3.4 inspected); MCST 2014-0039 press + korean.go.kr Q&A
principles.summary: Horizontal half-width ,. vs vertical full-width; paren spacing rules incl 1/8-em sign/math-Hangul; NIKL: attach periods/commas, big/small quote roles.

principles.applicability: None validated; community compensations are anecdotal.
principles.author: No source found (KLREQ, kore-gap, Source Han/Noto, Pretendard all wght-only)
principles.derivedPrinciple: Do not encode opsz compensation; flag display-size CJK adjustments as experimental.
principles.implementationStatus: not-applicable (correctly absent)
principles.limitations: Effectively no data; unresolved.
principles.principle: Hangul/CJK optical-size axis: no evidence (gap).
principles.reference: Searched KLREQ, kore-gap, Source Han/Noto CJK variable (wght-only 100-900), Pretendard variable (wght 45-930); none define opsz
principles.summary: No Hangul/CJK opsz axis or authoritative guidance found; drop-0.5-1pt / -2~-4% tracking compensations are anecdotal.

principles.applicability: Display sizes converge per Material; KR-specific sizing is unvalidated.
principles.author: Material Design v1 (partial); practitioner consensus (secondary)
principles.derivedPrinciple: Apply +1sp Title-Caption for Korean; above Title, English size is suitable; KR display tweaks experimental.
principles.implementationStatus: missing
principles.limitations: No controlled KR-vs-EN headline-size/readability study located.
principles.principle: KR vs EN headlines: Material +1sp rule; practitioner display lore.
principles.reference: https://m1.material.io/style/typography.html (Dense +1sp; larger-than-Title converges; inspected)
principles.sourceTitle: Material v1 Korean sizing + practitioner headline lore
principles.summary: Dense +1sp applies Title-Caption; larger than Title, English size suitable; KR slightly-smaller/-tracking/1.15-1.35 lore unvalidated.

principles.applicability: Even-space default; 1-char first-line indent; widow control for short last lines.
principles.author: W3C KLREQ; CSS text-justify-i18n draft
principles.derivedPrinciple: Even-space (both-edge) alignment default; never expand around parens/punct; 1-char indent.
principles.implementationStatus: partial (no justification aligns; indent/widow missing)
principles.limitations: kore-gap edge features (vertical controls, emphasis, counters) largely TBD.
principles.principle: Hangul justification/indent/widow control.
principles.reference: https://www.w3.org/TR/klreq/ (7.2 inspected); CSS text-justify-i18n open draft (Korean prefers expanding spaces)
principles.summary: Even-space alignment is Hangul default; line-adjust expands inter-char/word space but not around parens/punct; first-line indent 1 char; widow control.

scope: Typodeck 90+ program: classical/modern typography (A), perception/cognition (B), presentation-specific (C), Korean/multilingual (D). Concise paraphrases only; no copyrighted reproduction.
